Q1: no 1 s sample with non-owned CPU above 1.0 core. Q2: no 5 s rolling mean of non-owned CPU above 0.5 core. The pre-observation is evaluated once: if it fails, record PENDING and run no benchmark process (no retry loop). If a violation occurs during the processes, every run overlapping it is marked affected; nothing is replaced or added.
